title: FMD in an enterprise data landscape
description: FMD is one component in a platform, not a platform. This page places it: what feeds it, what consumes it, what it costs to run, what a governance review will ask of it, how it is secured, how it is promoted from development to production, and who has to get out of bed when it fails.
